title: ClientTypingEvent
description: Tell the chat that you are (not) typing or recording a voice message. Not acknowledged, so it carries no `client_temp_id`. Send `is_typing: true` again every few seconds while it lasts and `false` when it ends; receivers hide it when it is not repeated. Dropped when your `typing_indicators_enabled` privacy setting is off.

action.description: What you are doing. Without it, `typing`.
